name: Cinematic presentation and README
description: It is projected on a large screen. Dark theme, large type, an opening title, a visible synthetic-data disclaimer, and a README that lets anyone run it in one minute. Polish is last and must not touch the engine.

userStories.title: Dark cinematic layout
userStories.description: Full-viewport dark background, the particle field as the hero, the chart and statistics panel beside or below it, statistics in very large type readable from the back of a room, controls grouped and labelled. Baseline and improved use two restrained, distinct colours.
acceptanceCriteria: At 1920x1080 the age and surviving-population figures are at least 64px tall and the layout has no scrollbars
At 1280x720 nothing overlaps and the controls remain usable
No external fonts or stylesheets; system font stack only

userStories.title: Opening title and disclaimer
userStories.description: Before the first Play the page shows '1,000,000 LIVES' as a large title over the full particle field; it fades out on Play. A footer line reads 'Synthetic mortality assumptions for illustration only. Not for real actuarial use.' and is always visible.
acceptanceCriteria: The title is visible on load and gone within 1 second of pressing Play
The disclaimer is visible at both tested resolutions

userStories.title: README and engineering log
userStories.description: README.md explains what the app is, the formula, the terminal-age convention, how to run it (serve command, test command, regenerate table), and the disclaimer. ENGINEERING_LOG.md lists the decisions made and any known limitations.
acceptanceCriteria: A new reader can run the app and the tests from README alone
README states that the particle field is a display of the engine's numbers and introduces no randomness into the calculation
ENGINEERING_LOG.md has at least one entry per PRD with the decision taken and the test result

technicalNotes.rationale: CSS, copy and documentation. No logic.
